# Jayanthaa

> Security Analyst (SOC / Threat Management) — Threat Management L1 monitoring, endpoint security operations, SIEM log analysis, and incident documentation across multi-vendor IT environments.

Jayanthaa is currently working as an IT Help Desk Support Engineer (Security & GRC Support) at VDart, and shares practical blue-team knowledge for freshers via a blog.

## Experience

- **IT Help Desk Support Engineer — Security & GRC Support**, VDart, Trichy (2026 — Present)
  - Threat Management L1 monitoring of endpoint alerts via Sophos Endpoint Security
  - Log analysis across a multi-vendor, multi-protocol IT environment
  - Logged, triaged, and resolved 150+ IT support tickets via ManageEngine ServiceDesk (Zoho)
  - Supported Internal Audit (GRC) with compliance documentation and evidence collection
  - Tools used: Sophos Endpoint Security, Splunk, Elastic Stack (ELK), Wazuh, VirusTotal, IDS/IPS, MITRE ATT&CK, ManageEngine ServiceDesk, Windows Event Logs, Linux, TCP/IP, DNS, Git
